name: Asahina Akari
source:
Asahina is a third year middle school student at Nihon Daiichi Academy and a classmate of Shizuku and Akira. She tells Shizuku that she has done naked week 9 times already because she started in kindergarten so she is used to boys staring at her during the week and being naked in front of crowds doesn't bother her.

Because Shizuku peed herself and passed out from embarrassment during her public speech while naked Akari is often assigned to go with her to public events so that Shizuku isn't alone.
